headline: Global ETF Rotation Analysis: Energy and Health Care Maintain Leadership Amid Broad Sector Divergence
market_regime: Selective Leadership with Defensive and Commodity Sector Focus
executive_summary: Quantitative analysis indicates strong relative strength in Energy (XLE, IXC) and Health Care (XLV, XPH, IXJ, XBI), which persist as top global leaders. Emerging rotation signals appear in Oil Services (OIH) and International Small Caps (VSS), though both exhibit mixed relative strength across 20-bar and 63-bar horizons. Conversely, Consumer Discretionary sub-sectors such as Retail (XRT) and Industrials components like Aerospace & Defense (ITA) show persistent weakening, with ITA reaching a 63-bar score low of 22.65.

Relative strength across horizons is mixed, registering 13.98 percentage points over 20 bars and -0.47 percentage points over 63 bars.
